$description: Accepted misses of the touching-pair check (brand-creator contrast). One entry per pair and mode, each with the reason it is accepted. An entry that matches nothing is reported as stale.

exceptions.reason: The dot is a detail inside the body and the shape, not the colour, carries it: the logo sheet proves it stays visible at 16 px. The brighter accent cannot go darker without losing its contrast against the dark ground.
